name: Yellow-legged Pigeon
rangeDescription: Bismarck archipelago and solomon islands
description: Body is mostly iridescent green below and dark blue above and on the wings, with diagnostic bright yellow legs and a bright silver head with pinkish yellow-tipped bill. Most often seen in flight in small flocks over forest canopy at dusk and dawn, where flocking behavior and combination of silver head and bright yellow legs are diagnostic.

name: Abyssinian Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Savanna and juniper highlands of ethiopia and eritrea
description: A small, short-tailed woodpecker of the Abyssinian highlands. Note the pure golden-green back and the white facial streaks that frame a dark cheek.

name: Olive-capped Coua
rangeDescription: Lowlands of southwestern madagascar
description: Long-tailed, long-legged understory bird with a brownish-green cap. Found in spiny forest at low elevations in southwestern Madagascar.

name: Santa Marta Parakeet
rangeDescription: Santa marta mountains (northeastern colombia)
description: Long tailed and rather plain parakeet endemic to Colombia’s Santa Marta Mountains. The thick, white eye ring and red blotches on face and breast are its best features.

name: Golden-naped Barbet
rangeDescription: Mountains of northern borneo
description: The highest-ranging of Borneo’s endemic barbets, found in montane forest from 1000 m up to 3000 m or more. Stunning emerald-green with neon-powder-blue crown and throat; namesake golden nape only visible from certain angles.

name: Bare-headed Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: Highlands of northeastern borneo
description: Thickset, dark-gray-brown laughingthrush with a bright-candy-red bill, broad blue moustache patches, and a sickly-looking bare yellow crown. Endemic to the highlands of north-central Borneo.

name: Spotted Elachura
rangeDescription: Eastern nepal, northeastern india, and northeastern bangladesh to southeastern china (yunnan eastward, patchily, to fujian and guangdong), southward to west-central myanmar, central laos, and northwestern vietnam
description: Tiny wrenlike skulker with a large-headed and short-tailed profile. Brown overall with galaxy-like white spotting across the body and thick brick-red barring on the wings and tail.

name: Long-tailed Ground Dove
rangeDescription: West-central brazil (mato grosso) and adjacent bolivia
description: Unmistakable ground dove. Brownish above and whitish below.

name: Olive-chested Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Tropical eastern ecuador and northeastern peru (san martín)
description: Drab and unremarkable flycatcher found in the eastern foothills of the Andes in Ecuador and northern Peru. Note grayish-olive upperparts, dingy white underparts, yellow tinge to the belly, and pale wingbars.

name: Caroline Reed Warbler
rangeDescription: Caroline islands (yap including woleai and lamotrek, chuuk, pohnpei including nukuoro, and kosrae)
description: Medium-sized drab brown endemic of Micronesia’s Caroline Islands, where it inhabits a range of habitats, from native forest to degraded coastal scrub and patches of tall grass. Capable of persisting on even tiny coral atolls if there is sufficient vegetation.

name: Bali Myna
rangeDescription: Coastal northwestern bali (bali barat national park); extinct in the wild with reintroductions in nusa penida island and (usually unsuccessful) in western bali
description: An eye-catching white starling with black tips to the tail and wings, bare blue facial skin, and long plumes that hang down the nape. Juvenile is shorter-crested than adult, with yellow wash.

name: White-bellied Mountain-gem
rangeDescription: Caribbean slope of north-central costa rica to western panama
description: Medium-sized hummingbird, male mostly green above with purple throat, thin white line behind eye, and bright white belly. Female not quite as colorful but still unique with white belly and line behind eye; she has a spotted throat.

name: Black-spectacled Brushfinch
rangeDescription: Andes of southern peru (ayacucho and huancavelica)
description: Rare brushfinch with a highly restricted range in the eastern Andes of central Peru. It has an ornate head pattern with a partial black mask bordered by chestnut, black-and-white mustache stripes, and a white spot between the eye and the bill.

name: White Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Dry forest of south america east of the andes to northern argentina
description: Strikingly-plumaged medium-sized woodpecker, mostly white with dark wings and back contrasting with yellow goggles with a dark eye stripe. Males have a yellowish nape.

name: Ash-throated Casiornis
rangeDescription: Caatinga and scrub of northeastern brazil
description: Large rufous flycatcher with a slight crest, a cinnamon back, dusky flight feathers, and buff underparts. Inhabits wooded caatinga (dry scrubby forest) in the breeding season, with migrants also found in Cerrado and Amazonian savannas and light woodland in the non-breeding season.

name: Gray-green Scrubwren
rangeDescription: Humid montane forest of new guinea
description: A small bird of lower montane forest interior. Whitish belly, pale gray head and greenish wing.

name: Doria's Hawk
rangeDescription: New guinea, including and batanta (raja ampat islands, off western new guinea)
description: A large, inconspicuous raptor of lowlands and foothill forest interior. Brown back and long tail with strong barring, pale underparts with strong sparse streaking, pale eye-brow and a thick dark eye-stripe.

name: Black-tailed Antbird
rangeDescription: Tropical northeastern peru and adjacent brazil (far western amazonas)
description: Uncommon and range-restricted in western Amazonia. This shy, secretive antbird prefers the dense, shrubby understory vegetation in seasonally flooded forests and other similar habitats.

name: Baudo Guan
rangeDescription: West slope of andes of colombia and ecuador
description: Medium-sized turkeylike bird restricted to very wet rainforest in lowlands and foothills of western Colombia and northwestern Ecuador. It is dark brown with white streaks on the underparts and a red dewlap.

name: White-capped Bunting
rangeDescription: Southern turkmenistan to northern afghanistan, northern pakistan and northwestern india
description: Male’s elegant black-and-white facial pattern is unique. Female is plain, streaky brown all over with faint white eye-ring, a weak hint of the male’s facial pattern, and a small white spot on the “ears”.
